name: Three Little Pigs
description: The team rates its work as a house of straw, sticks or bricks: how solid is it? A fun picture that makes quality and risks easy to talk about.

columns.name: Straw
columns.prompt: What is weak and could fall over easily?

columns.name: Sticks
columns.prompt: What is okay but could be stronger?

columns.name: Bricks
columns.prompt: What is solid and we can rely on?

mood.energized: A story everybody knows, light and fun.

goal.fun: The fairy tale makes it playful.
goal.bond: A shared story gets the team laughing.
goal.reflect-project: Shows how solid the work is.

checkInQuestion: Which fairy tale or story character are you today, and why?
facilitationTips: Retell the story in a few words so everyone has the picture.
Place sticky notes on a drawn house or a three-part board.
End with how to turn straw into bricks: choose one thing to strengthen.
